title: Premium Transparent Windshield Card Holder - Crystal Clear Acrylic Sleeve Equipped with Heat-Resistant 3M VHB Adhesive for RFID Passes, Parking Permits, and Smart Cards (Universal Fit)
description: Upgrade your vehicle with this sleek acrylic sleeve, designed to eliminate messy sticker residue on your windscreen. It provides a permanent, protective home for highway passes, parking permits, and RFID smart cards. Crafted from optical-grade, shatter-resistant acrylic, it offers 100% signal transparency. This allows automated overhead scanners and gate sensors to read your credentials instantly. Equipped with heavy-duty 3M VHB tape, the holder withstands intense dashboard heat without melting or sliding. The convenient top-loading slot fits standard cards, letting you swap tags/cards smoothly while keeping your windshield organized and pristine.
Name: Premium Transparent Windshield Card Holder - Crystal Clear Acrylic Sleeve Equipped with Heat-Resistant 3M VHB Adhesive for RFID Passes, Parking Permits, and Smart Cards (Universal Fit)
